title: Test: did the notification work?
ask: Did a notification arrive on your phone, and did tapping it open this screen?
details:
This checks the whole loop: Claude writes a question → Gemini's script sends it → your phone buzzes → you tap an answer → Claude reads it.

**YES** = all worked. **NO** = something didn't (add a note: no buzz, or the tap opened the wrong screen).

title: Ship the parent-consent screens (row X)?
ask: Students who signed up alone see "Ask a parent or guardian" until a parent links them or they join a class. Plus College / grown-up and "say it appreciate". Ship it?
details:
**What changes for kids:** a student with no parent linked and no class sees only the "Ask a parent or guardian" screen: send a WhatsApp message to the parent, type the parent's code, or join a class with a code. Nothing is saved before a parent says yes (India's DPDP Act and Google Play's family rules).

**Your 3 yeses are in:** College / grown-up (year of birth, 18+ skips the gate), "parent or guardian" wording, sign-in says "appreciate" out loud once.

**Before it ships:** link Pratha to your account (Me → Link my child's own account), or she sees the gate too. Gemini's test account Sam also gets the gate (good: it tests it).

**YES** = Claude merges and publishes to everyone on 20.0.30. Mockup: rows X1–X5 on the canvas (link above).

title: The one old student with no parent
ask: One account (Class 5, signed up April 2025) has no parent linked. Delete it only if no parent says yes within 14 days after the gate ships?
details:
Found by Gemini (G45). After the gate ships, this child sees "Ask a parent or guardian" on their next open. If nobody says yes in 14 days, the account and its data are deleted (same deletion as "Delete my account").

**YES** = wait 14 days, then delete. **NO** = keep it (say why in the note).

title: Store name and text
ask: Use "Apprec8: Learn & Grow", the short description "Fun, calm daily learning for Classes 1–12: English, Science and more. No ads." and feature graphic draft 2?
details:
The full description is in My notes → Store listing. It starts "Apprec8 (say it "appreciate") helps children learn a little every day…" and lists subjects as "English and Science today, with Maths and reasoning coming next".

![Feature graphic](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mohitcnsia/images@main/apprec8-feature-graphic-draft2.png)

**YES** = paste it into Play Console (Store listing). **MORE DETAILS** = Claude explains or changes it.

title: "Your first day" card on Home for new children?
ask: New children see a small card on Home, "⭐ Your first day · 0 of 4", until they finish the 4 guide steps. Add it?
details:
Today the guides sit in Me → Guides, where a new child won't look. The card would sit under the quests, calm (one line + a small progress bar), and disappear for good after the 4th step or after 7 days. Tapping it opens the guide.

**YES** = Claude draws a mockup first, then builds it. **NO** = guides stay in Me only.
note: This should be everyone. Every time app is opened and if they deliberately close it. Then on we don't show but tell them once where it can be found

title: A "What's new" card after each update?
ask: After an update, grown-ups see one card on Me: "What's new: 3 things", each with a DO IT button that opens the screen. Add it?
details:
Helps you, Seema, parents and teachers keep up as features arrive (you said you can't follow them all anymore). Children don't see it. One card per update, dismissed with one tap.

**YES** = mockup first, then build. **NO** = the App map in My notes is enough.

title: Mockup: guide card on Home + What's new
ask: Your 2 yeses as screens (canvas row Y, 4 screens). Build it like this?
details:
**Y1/Y2 Home:** a calm card above the quests: children see "Your first day · 1 of 4", grown-ups "Tour of Apprec8". It shows on every open until all steps are done or ✕ is tapped (your note).

**Y3 after ✕:** one green note, "The guides are always in Me → Guides", then never again.

**Y4 Me:** "What's new · 3 things" for grown-ups after each update, each with DO IT (opens that screen). ✕ hides it until the next update. Children never see it.

**YES** = Claude builds it and asks you before publishing.

title: Task for tomorrow: 12+ testers (C10)
ask: Set up the testers' Google Group and send the WhatsApp message. Tap YES when done, LATER to be reminded in 24 hours, MORE DETAILS if you're stuck.
details:
**1. Google Group (laptop, 5 min):** groups.google.com → Create group → name "Apprec8 testers", email `apprec8-testers`. Who can join: anyone on the web. Who can see members / post / view conversations: **group managers only**.

**2. Play Console (5 min):** Test and release → Testing → Closed testing → Apprec8 → **Testers** → Google Groups → `apprec8-testers@googlegroups.com` → Save. Copy the **Join on the web** link.

**3. WhatsApp to 15–16 grown-ups** (parents, family, friends, Seema and colleagues):
1) Join: https://groups.google.com/g/apprec8-testers → Join group
2) Become a tester: (the Join on the web link)
3) Install after Sunday: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mohitchilkoti.apprec8
"Please stay in the group for 2 weeks."

Google's 14-day clock starts once 12 have opted in. Full steps: My notes → Play forms.

title: Did you re-seed English?
ask: Admin tools → Update English Quest, after 5 Nov. Without it, Grammar Pro (Class 9–10) isn't on phones. Done?
details: **YES** = done. **NO** = not yet: do it now (2 minutes; close and reopen the app first). **LATER** = remind me tomorrow.

title: Task: Seema's pilot prep
ask: 3 things before students join: Seema checks Grammar Pro questions, a 30-minute dry run with her, the school's consent form. Tap YES when done, LATER for a reminder.
details:
**Dry run (owner + Seema):** you: Me → Guides → Set up a school (school, class 10-B, invite Seema). Seema: Join as a teacher → you approve → Me → Guides → Start your class with 2 test students → **assign a Grammar Pro topic** (Class 10 students otherwise start at the basics).

**Students:** they join the testers' Google Group too, so they also count for Google's 12 testers (C10).

The WhatsApp message for students and parents is ready: My notes → Seema's pilot (after the next publish).

title: 🔊 Listen button on the parent's consent note?
ask: Many parents can't read well. Add a 🔊 Listen button that reads the consent note aloud (हिंदी or English), on Join a class and Link my child?
details:
Uses the phone's voice, the same as the quiz read-aloud. No new data, no cost. One small button next to the note; the parent still types their name and ticks agree.

**YES** = Claude builds it (small change) and asks before publishing. **NO** = leave as is.

title: What confuses Seema most?
ask: Ask Seema for her 3 biggest confusions in the app, in her own words. Type them in the note, then tap YES.
details:
Before we build anything else, we fix what confuses her: if she finds it hard, every teacher will.

Her one-page start (4 jobs, what to ignore, the legal part in plain words) is here; share it with her from the page's Share menu:
https://claude.ai/artifact/PCE2qk5THfuR22SKXehBr5

Then 20 minutes together on the Demo School teacher login (made-up class, nothing reaches real children).

title: Simplicity first: pause new features?
ask: Pause new features (Dog Squad, What's new, Home guide card) until the 5 most common jobs take 2 taps or fewer. Pilot, fixes and content go on.
details:
**The 5 jobs:** a child continues learning (one big ▶ Continue at the bottom of Home), a child fixes mistakes, a parent sees their child's week (on Home), a teacher sees their class (on Home), anyone finds help.

Everything else folds under **More** on Me (nothing deleted). Claude counts today's taps for each job, draws a mockup (row Z) and asks you here before building.

**YES** = pause + simplicity pass now. **NO** = keep building features.

title: A "View as" switch for you?
ask: Your account sees about twice what a child sees. Add an owner-only switch: View as child · parent · teacher, to see exactly what they see?
details:
Your Home also shows Explore, More practice, old classrooms, the Fun tab, every unit open and admin. That makes the app feel more complex to you (and to Seema on your phone) than it is for a child.

The switch changes only what your phone shows; nothing is saved to anyone.

**YES** = build it with the simplicity pass.

title: Row X change: children learn right away?
ask: Instead of blocking, children learn right away on the phone with nothing saved to their name. A parent's yes is needed only to save stars, join a class or appear on leaderboards. OK?
details:
Today's row X stops a child who signed up alone at "Ask a parent". That ends "log in and learn right away", which is what you liked.

**New idea:** the child learns at once; progress stays on the phone and nothing identifies them. A small card says "Ask a parent to save your stars ⭐" (the same 2 ways: parent's code or a class code).

Legally sound in our reading (nothing about the child is stored under their name before the yes), but a lawyer checks before the public release.

**YES** = Claude redraws row X like this (mockup first). **NO** = keep the gate as designed.

title: What confused you most?
ask: Type the 2–3 moments in the app that confused you or took too many taps (e.g. "finding my mistakes", "where is Pratha's progress"). Then tap YES.
details: These go first in the simplicity pass, together with Seema's.
